research.name: react-nprogress
research.note: Headless React hook and render-prop port of nprogress that supplies trickling progress state and leaves the bar markup and CSS to you.

effects: headless trickle progress state: hook returns progress, isFinished and animationDuration and renders no markup or CSS

unverified: The demo was not viewed: the README and repository tree contain no screenshots or recordings, and the only live examples are CodeSandbox devboxes, which returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and need a browser.
The signature effect is taken from the README's description of the API, not from seeing a progress bar running; the visual result depends entirely on the bar the consumer writes.
